title: DockerAlignStepConfig
description: Operator-pinned generic Docker aligner knobs (actionConfig.docker_align). Derived from workers/methyl_worker/docker_align_runner.py (image, argv/command, extra_docker_args, gpu_flags). No code-sourced defaults; missing image or argv fails at runtime.

image.description: Docker image. Required at runtime unless METHYL_DOCKER_ALIGN_IMAGE is set. docker_align_runner.py.

argv.description: Command template (list of strings, or a single string that is shlex-split). Placeholders: {r1},{r2},{bam},{reference},{sample_dir}, {sample_id},{bam_dir},{metrics_dir}. Alias: command. docker_align_runner.py.

extra_docker_args.description: Extra docker run arguments (list or shlex-split string). Alias: extraDockerArgs. docker_align_runner.py.

gpu_flags.description: Docker GPU flags (list or shlex-split string). Alias: gpuFlags. docker_align_runner.py.
